chunks: As for what Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad narrated from Muḥammad ibn Ismāʿīl, from ʿAlī ibn al-Nuʿmān, from Isḥāq ibn ʿAmmār, from ʿUqbah ibn Muṣʿab, who said:

I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام and said: Which is better: that I perform the rakʿahs earlier on Friday, or that I pray them after the obligatory prayer? He said: No; rather, pray them after the obligatory prayer.

key_terms.أَفْضَلُ: more virtuous or preferable in legal practice
key_terms.الرَّكَعَاتِ: units of prayer, here referring to supererogatory prayers
key_terms.يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ: Friday, the day of congregational Friday worship

ai.seo_question: Is it better to perform the Friday supererogatory rakʿahs before or after the obligatory prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith records a legal question posed to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام about the timing of supererogatory rakʿahs on Friday. The Imam عليه السلام replies that they should be performed after the obligatory prayer, indicating a ruling concerning the preferred order of Friday prayers.
